protections: Admin-supplied setting values that are spliced into LESS source must not be able to make the LESS compiler read local files or fetch URLs (no @import / data-uri reachable from settings content); one protection covering custom_less and the less-config variables, since both feed the same Less_Parser at framework/core/src/Frontend/Compiler/LessCompiler.php:93-110

traps.reason_to_dismiss: Under the theme-colour (B) report, custom_less is admin-authored LESS by design and the report never mentions it; admins are trusted to write arbitrary styles
evidence: framework/core/src/Forum/ForumServiceProvider.php:118-119 (custom_less setting added raw as a LESS string source)
framework/core/src/Forum/ValidateCustomLess.php:60-91 (only a trial compile; the only rejection is a parser exception, no @import/data-uri check)
framework/core/src/Api/Controller/SetSettingsController.php:47-56 (admin body saved key by key after the Saving event)
framework/core/src/Frontend/Compiler/LessCompiler.php:93-110 (Less_Parser parses string sources with no import restriction)

traps.reason_to_dismiss: The admin UI only offers a colour picker for these settings, so a solver may treat them as colour-shaped (relevant under the A/custom_less report; under the B report the route is named)
evidence: framework/core/src/Frontend/FrontendServiceProvider.php:139-144 (theme_primary_color / theme_secondary_color have no callback, unlike dark-mode/colored-header at 145-156)
framework/core/src/Frontend/FrontendServiceProvider.php:43-44 (base CSS with these vars is added to every asset bundle, forum and admin and locale)

traps.reason_to_dismiss: Extension-registered LESS config vars are the extension's responsibility and no bundled extension registers one; also they must keep accepting free-form values, so a colour-only rule cannot apply
evidence: framework/core/src/Extend/Settings.php:82 (key and optional callback stored, no value validation)
framework/core/src/Extend/Settings.php:136 (merged into flarum.less.config, same interpolation loop at FrontendServiceProvider.php:198-207)
framework/core/tests/integration/extenders/SettingsTest.php:244-259 (must keep working: free-form value 'customValue' compiles into CSS)

conflicts.what: The natural fix for T2 (strict colour/hex validation) applied at the shared interpolation loop FrontendServiceProvider.php:198-207 to all config vars would reject the free-form 'customValue' that SettingsTest.php:256 requires; the colour rule has to be per-key, and T3 needs a structural (no ';', '@import', 'data-uri', braces) rule instead

fairness_risks: A blanket '@import' ban on custom_less (T1) also refuses the common legitimate use '@import url(https://...)' for web fonts; tests must not expect that to keep working, or must say so in the report

A colour rule for theme_primary_color/theme_secondary_color must accept the hex defaults (SettingsServiceProvider.php:28-29); whether existing installs store non-hex colours (rgb(), named colours) is unverified, so tests should use only hex for the must-keep-working value
Extension LESS config vars must keep accepting plain identifiers such as 'customValue' (SettingsTest.php:244-259) and must keep rejecting '@muralf' with 422 (SettingsTest.php:264-279)

design.why: Best available is T2 (named route) + T1 (deepseek-type: parallel custom_less entry with a 'trusted admin LESS' reason to dismiss) + T3 (M11 coupled free-form extension var, mimo over-hardening risk). It falls short of the 3-5 independent target: T2 and T3 share one sink line (FrontendServiceProvider.php:206) and are one group, so only 2 independent groups exist. Worse, one compiler-layer fix (restrictive import_callback plus an overriding data-uri function in LessCompiler.php:93-114) closes all three at once (M3 collapse). Usable only as a 2-trap pair, not as a stacked task.
